## Choose a course

::: {.course-grid}
::: {.course-card}
### [Python Foundations](courses/python-foundations/index.qmd)

**Beginner · No prerequisite**

Learn core syntax, collections, functions, and debugging from zero programming
experience, then optionally deepen files, tooling, OOP, and Python patterns.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### [Intermediate Python: Applied Problem Solving](courses/intermediate-python/index.qmd)

**TBD · Requires Foundations**

Apply foundational tools to original challenges that emphasize parsing,
modeling, testing, refactoring, and explaining unfamiliar problems.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### [Advanced Python: Complex Problem Solving](courses/advanced-python/index.qmd)

**TBD · Requires Intermediate**

Solve multi-stage, constrained problems involving search, graphs, simulations,
performance, architecture, and engineering trade-offs.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### [Scientific Computing with Python](courses/scientific-python/index.qmd)

**In development · Requires Foundations**

Work with arrays, simulations, plots, symbolic mathematics, and scientific
algorithms.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### [Data Science and Machine Learning](courses/data-science-ml/index.qmd)

**In development · Requires Scientific Computing**

Move from a data question to a responsibly evaluated model and communicate the
evidence.
:::
:::

## How every course works

::: {.learning-loop}
1. **Understand** why the idea matters.
2. **Predict** what a small example will do.
3. **Run** it in Colab, Jupyter, VS Code, or the terminal.
4. **Explain** the result in everyday language.
5. **Modify** one small thing and predict again.
6. **Debug** using evidence instead of guessing.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Progress and certificates"}
Lesson progress is stored in your browser and organized by course. Python
Foundations now has published local completion requirements and a project rubric.
Verifiable certificates remain planned because they also require identity,
assessment evidence, and durable learner records. Browser completion is not
presented as a verified credential.
:::

## Shared help

- Use the [Python FAQ](resources/faq/index.qmd) when an error or output surprises you.
- Use the [Project Toolkit](resources/project-toolkit/index.qmd) to plan, test, document,
  and present course projects.
- Open the [full course catalog](courses/index.qmd) whenever you want to switch
  pathways.
